question: Published in May 2025, Pavan K Varma’s Echoes of Eternity explores themes from which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian thought from Rigveda onward**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Echoes of Eternity** is a significant literary work authored by **Pavan K Varma**, a renowned diplomat and writer, published in **May 2025**.
 
• The book serves as an extensive exploration of **Indian thought**, beginning with the **Rigveda**, which is considered the oldest of the four **Vedas** and a foundational text of **Indian philosophy**.
 
• The narrative traces the evolution of philosophical concepts over thousands of years, examining how ancient wisdom remains relevant in the **21st century**.
 
• The work focuses on the spiritual and metaphysical foundations of India, touching upon themes such as **Sanatana Dharma**, the nature of **consciousness**, and the continuity of the **Indian civilization**.
 
• Through this book, **Pavan K Varma** aims to make complex intellectual traditions accessible to a modern audience, bridging the gap between **ancient texts** and contemporary **societal values**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Author Profile:** **Pavan K Varma** is a former officer of the **Indian Foreign Service (IFS)** and has served as the **Ambassador of India** to several countries, including **Bhutan** and **Cyprus**. He has also been a member of the **Rajya Sabha**.
 
• **Literary Contributions:** He is well-known for his insightful books on **Indian culture** and **history**, such as **The Great Hindu Civilisation**, **Being Indian**, and **The Great Indian Middle Class**.
 
• **Significance of the Rigveda:** The **Rigveda** consists of **1,028 hymns** organized into **10 Mandalas**. It represents the earliest recorded form of **Indo-Aryan thought** and contains the **Gayatri Mantra**, which is central to **Hindu** tradition.
 
• **Context of the Book:** **Echoes of Eternity** emphasizes that **Indian thought** is not a static relic of the past but a living, breathing **intellectual heritage** that continues to influence global **spirituality** and **ethics**.
 
• **Theme of Continuity:** The book highlights the resilient nature of **Indian philosophical inquiry**, which has survived centuries of foreign invasions and **colonial rule** to remain a vital part of the nation's **identity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The book is released at a time when there is a growing global interest in **Indic knowledge systems** and **Vedic philosophy**.
 
• **Pavan K Varma** frequently utilizes his **diplomatic background** to provide a comparative perspective on how **Indian thought** differs from and complements **Western philosophical** traditions.
 
• The publication of **Echoes of Eternity** in **2025** marks another milestone in the author's career as a public **intellectual** and **cultural commentator**.
 
• Major themes in the book also include the concept of **Dharma**, the cycle of **Samsara**, and the pursuit of **Moksha**, which are core to the **Upanishadic** and **Vedic** eras.
